# Third-party skills

Third-party skills remain credited to their original authors. A pinned Git submodule records the exact reviewed source without implying local authorship.

| Skill | Author | Upstream | License | Integration | Reviewed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `avoid-ai-writing` | Conor Bronsdon | https://github.com/conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing | MIT | Pinned, unmodified source plus a local compatibility adapter | 2026-08-20 |

The repository and its `SKILL.md`, package scripts, detector code, and maintenance history were reviewed before inclusion. No third-party scripts are executed as part of installation. The adapter loads the pinned instructions only when relevant. The user's `writing-voice` rules remain authoritative; this skill is an optional audit layer, not a replacement voice.
